const axios = require('axios')

async function saveNowDownloader(videoUrl, format = '1440') {
  try {
    const apiUrl = 'https://p.savenow.to/ajax/download.php'

    const startReq = await axios.get(apiUrl, {
      params: {
        copyright: 0,
        format: format,
        url: videoUrl,
        api: 'dfcb6d76f2f6a9894gjkege8a4ab232222'
      },
      headers: {
        accept: '*/*',
        origin: 'https://downloaderto.com',
        referer: 'https://downloaderto.com/',
        'user-agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/142.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'
      }
    })

    const info = startReq.data
    if (!info.success || !info.id) {
      return {
        code: 500,
        message: 'Gagal memulai proses download',
        timestamp: Date.now()
      }
    }

    const progressId = info.id
    const progressUrl = 'https://p.savenow.to/api/progress'

    let finalUrl = null
    let statusText = ''
    let currentProgress = 0

    while (true) {
      const pr = await axios.get(progressUrl, {
        params: { id: progressId },
        headers: {
          accept: '*/*',
          origin: 'https://downloaderto.com',
          referer: 'https://downloaderto.com/',
          'user-agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/142.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'
        }
      })

      const data = pr.data
      currentProgress = data.progress
      statusText = data.text

      if (data.success === 1 && data.download_url) {
        finalUrl = data.download_url
        break
      }

      if (currentProgress >= 1000) {
        finalUrl = data.download_url
        break
      }

      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800))
    }

    return {
      code: 200,
      title: info.title,
      id: progressId,
      status: statusText,
      progress: currentProgress,
      download: finalUrl,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    }

  } catch (e) {
    return {
      code: 500,
      message: e.message,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    }
  }
}
